notes.title: 11/04/2025 (1.2.0) release notes
notes.content:
Release Changes Notes:
---------------------------
- Added 3 bosses in Village Mode that appear at the end of each year in the game.
- Added an Animal Ecosystem system where herbivores and carnivores have needs like Thirst, Hunger, Sleep and Reproduction that must be satisfied.
- Added a second world customization option (Terrain Type) that determines the size of the map.
- Added a third world customization option (Spawn Animals) that determines if wild animals are added to the map.
- Added two new buildings (Sawmill and Quarry) that help acquire resources more efficiently. ;)
- Optimized the preview of the area where construction is not possible (the red area that appear when selecting a building), as it used to cause a brief lag each time this action was performed.
- Changed the text font, redesign of the health bar, added an item/building's description tooltip that appear when hovering it.
- Fixed various bugs and glitches.

notes.title: 10/03/2025 (1.1.0) release notes
notes.content:
Most significant changes:
----------------------------
- Playable races added.
- Added island generation system via seed.
- 8 new structures with new features added.
- Dock, blacksmith and hospital functionalities modified and adapted to the new gameplay.
- 2 bosses added to Exploration mode.
- Enemy AI updated and improved.
- New combat style added (Mage).
- Added basic magic system.
- New interface for building structures by category.
- New jobs for villagers added.
- Village storage system functionality added.
- Many bugs and glitches fixed.
